reasons.nose_turning_deg: law 1: largest turning per ring cell [deg]: 10 at M (accuracy target, decision 71); VC is 2 levels coarser: x 1.3^2 = 16.9
reasons.te_spacing_c: law 3: trailing-edge cell / local chord: 0.001 at M (accuracy target, decision 71; DPW, Levy et al. 2013); VC is 2 levels coarser: x 1.3^2 = 0.00169
reasons.max_spacing_c: largest ring cell / local chord: 0.02 at M (accuracy target, decision 71; our starting value); VC is 2 levels coarser: x 1.3^2 = 0.0338
reasons.base_cells: law 6: cells across the blunt base: 8 at VC (hard minimum, decision 71), this level
reasons.chord_growth: growth that builds the ring's size field: 1.2 at VC (hard minimum, decision 71), this level
reasons.chord_growth_limit: checked growth between ring cells: 1.25 at VC (hard minimum, decision 71; Stage 1 handover; DPW), this level
reasons.cells_per_bubble: band cells across a laminar bubble: 20 at F (transition target, decision 71; Ansys CFX guide, decision 56); VC is 3 levels coarser: / 1.3^3 = 9.103
reasons.span_spacing_c: law 8: station gap / local chord: 0.25 at M (accuracy target, decisions 71, 72); VC is 2 levels coarser: x 1.3^2 = 0.4225
reasons.min_cells_per_panel: fewest station gaps per panel: 12 at M (accuracy target, decision 71); VC is 2 levels coarser: / 1.3^2, rounded up = 8
reasons.span_growth: growth that builds the station gaps: 1.2 at VC (first approach's value, unchanged), this level
reasons.span_growth_limit: checked growth between station gaps: 1.3 at VC (Stage 1 handover; unchanged), this level
reasons.yplus: law 13: y+ of the first wall cell (for the tip gap): 1 at VC (hard minimum, decision 71), this level
reasons.tip_gap_in_s0: law 10: last station gap = 2 x the tip first cell s0, at every level; s0 follows this level's y+ (1)

check_rules.nose_turning: <= 17.10 deg (VC: 16.9 + 0.2) at every ring node but the trailing-edge corners and geometry kinks (law 1)
check_rules.geometry_kinks: <= 17.10 deg (VC's turning limit): a kink of the section itself (trailing-edge opening on very small chords) that no cell size can reduce
check_rules.chord_growth: <= 1.25 (VC) within 1 % (the lower side follows the upper side's arc fraction; where the two noses differ, open decision 64, its first cells grow a little faster)
check_rules.band_spacing: <= 1 x the band cell asked at VC (bubble length / 9.1), within 1 %
check_rules.te_spacing: <= 1 x the trailing-edge cell asked at VC (0.169 % c; law 3), within 1 %
check_rules.loft_stations_hit: a station exactly on every loft station [m]
check_rules.tip_gap: in [0.8, 1.01] x the tip gap asked at VC (2 x s0 at y+ 1; law 10)
check_rules.planar_stations: every ring in its station plane [m]
check_rules.cap_quads: >= 0.05 (scaled Jacobian, all but the two nose-corner cells)
check_rules.cap_nose_corners: > 0, not folded (the H cap puts two corners on the smooth nose: angle 180 deg - turning)

cell_estimate.formula: n = max_j ceil(ln(1 + (g-1) D/s0_j) / ln g); cells = (n_ring-1)(n_span-1) n + cap_quads n
